text:
Alex Kim: follow-up from the canary-a/b fallback thread. want to pin down a small runtime <-> router contract for graceful model downgrades (e.g. fp16 -> int8) when token budgets or p95 latency spike. thoughts?
Maria Ortiz: big yes. we need a compact capability descriptor the runtime serves so router can pick compatible variants. avoid ad hoc checks in router code.
Cheng Li: what fields are minimal? i'm thinking `id`, `capabilities`, `cache_compat_id`, `max_output_tokens`, `streaming` flag, and a `rehydrate_hint` string.
Samir Patel: add `warmup_cost_estimate` too. ops needs an estimate for rewarming cache to decide staged vs immediate switch.
Alex Kim: agreed. sample shape (informal): `capabilities: {quant: [fp16,int8], kv_layout: v2, streaming: true, max_out: 1024}`. `cache_compat_id` = "gpt3-small-v2-cache-v1".
Jules Rivera: important: tenant-private deployments must be able to deny variants. add `allowed_variants` to tenant policy and router must respect it.
Maria Ortiz: yes — implement allowlist at control-plane + per-tenant routing policy. router returns next candidate if 403/denied.
Cheng Li: on in-flight requests: streaming can't be cut mid-response. rule: only switch at request boundary for streaming. for sync/batched, router marks new requests for fallback and drains old workers.
Samir Patel: ops: what triggers the switch? local node telemetry should enforce soft-limits and emit `degrade_event` to control-plane. control-plane aggregates and issues `decision_id` to routers.
Alex Kim: event schema proposal: `node_id, metric, value, threshold, window, suggested_action, decision_id`. include optional `evidence_uri` for trace links.
Jules Rivera: controls: three fallback modes: `immediate`, `staged`, `shadow`. immediate = route new traffic to fallback; staged = percent steps; shadow = mirror but don't affect production responses.
Maria Ortiz: staged must be abortable and reversible. decision model should support `abort=true` or `promote=true` for a `decision_id`.
Cheng Li: cache migration: if cache_compat_id mismatches, options are: (1) evict and rewarm, (2) proxy kv reads to old pool until warm, (3) keep hybrid pool for TTL. each has cost tradeoffs. we should default to proxying for short windows.
Samir Patel: for telemetry attach `decision_id` to traces and metrics. surface `tokens_saved`, `latency_delta_p95`, `error_rate_delta` per step. keep a per-decision rollup.
Alex Kim: propose a routing_policy proto (pseudo):
```
routing_policy:
  name: size-fallback-cost-slo
  trigger:
    metric: p95_latency_ms
    threshold: 220
    window: 2m
  fallback:
    mode: staged
    variants:
      - name: gpt3-s-int8
        allow_if: tenant_allowlist
      - name: gpt3-s-fp16
    stages: [10,50,100]
    step_interval: 15m
  cache_policy:
    on_switch: proxy_reads | evict | rehydrate
    compat_check: true
```
Jules Rivera: UX idea: a `preview` endpoint that accepts a canned traffic sample and returns compatibility report + simulated cost/latency impact. product teams can run before enabling staged rollout.
Maria Ortiz: implement preview in control-plane. require `tenant_approval` for private deployments.
Cheng Li: noise handling: signal aggregation should use robust stats (median of p95 across nodes, or anomaly detector). avoid single-node flaps causing global switch.
Samir Patel: dashboard bits: show `active_decisions`, `decision_id`, current stage, tokens_saved, rollback_count, per-tenant allowlist violations. include links to traces.
Alex Kim: next actions: I'll draft the runtime contract PR (capabilities + cache_compat_id + switch API), Cheng will draft cache migration strategies, Jules will spec preview API, Samir will extend tracing spec. Maria to review tenant allowlist/workflow.
deploy-bot: job canary/fallback-contract-check queued (job id dj-2026-115) :rocket:
Maria Ortiz: tiny note: document safe defaults (no auto-fallback unless opted-in) and require opt-in for hosted customers.
Cheng Li: good call. default to `shadow` mode for first 24h, then staged if team promotes.
Samir Patel: I'll prototype a small canary calculator to estimate rewarm cost and latency delta per variant.
Alex Kim: thanks all. aim for PRs this week and a dev-sandbox prototype next week. :thumbsup:
